policy.textures: downsize only, never upscale; same image format and mime type; alpha and colour chunks kept
policy.textureEdges: each image records its treatment and maximumEdge: colour and unsampled images use the colour edge, normal and data maps their own; stricter512 sets all three to 512, maps512 only normal and data
policy.meshopt: EXT_meshopt_compression, lossless: attribute codec v0, index codec v1, no filters, no quantisation, no reordering
policy.standaloneTextures: not planned: a partial revision on 20261009-r04-a01 keeps the base's adopted standalone images
policy.provenance: deterministic derivatives of the original GLBs that 20261009-r04-a01's saved pre-apply manifests record, never of its served candidates; not a new model or image generation; originals unchanged

standaloneImagesSkipped: not planned: a partial revision on 20261009-r04-a01 keeps the base's adopted standalone images
